title: How Loud Should the Music Be?

cover.label: about as loud as you want to go

scenes.say: Great playlist. Shame nobody can hear each other.

scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.say: Sorry, what? I'll just nod. Next time, let's go somewhere quieter.
Diners rank noise near the top of their complaints. One study found the average Manhattan restaurant at seventy-eight decibels. Around seventy or below, people can still talk.
So: sit at a table and try to talk. Use a free decibel app and aim for seventy or under. And turn it up for the rush, down for the regulars.

props.title: Set the volume
steps: Sit at a table and try talking
Check an app: 70 dB or under
Louder in the rush, softer after
